description.text: Objectives Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine as well as the fundamental knowledge and skills on stomatology and its clinical treatments. These medical professionals should undertake medical diagnosis, treatments and prevention on common and frequently occurring diseases of oral cavity in health and medical institutions. Core Disciplines Basic Medicine & Clinical Medicine & Stomatology Major Courses Systematic Anatomy, Histoembryology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pathology, Immunology, Physical Diagnostics, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Laboratory Diagnosis, Surgery Pandect, Preventive Medicine, Oral Anatomy & Physiology, Oral Histology & Pathology, Dental Materials, Operative Dentistry & Endodontics, Periodontics, Oral Mucosa Diseases, Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Prosthetic Dentistry, Orthodontics, Preventive Dentistry, Otorhinolaryngology, Cytobiology Degree Awarded Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.

duration.text: The Stomatology at Tianjin Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6666 USD/per year ￥ 48000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18-30 years old. 4. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university
